name: SLayR benchmark suite
description: We introduce SLayR, Scene Layout Generation with Rectified flow, a novel transformer-based model for text-to-layout generation which can then be paired with existing layout-to-image models to produce images. SLayR addresses a domain in which current text-to-image pipelines struggle: generating scene layouts that are of significant variety and plausibility, when the given prompt is ambiguous and does not provide constraints on the scene. SLayR surpasses existing baselines including LLMs in unconstrained generation, and can generate layouts from an open caption set.
